reasons: The finding is claimed compliant and correctly proposes no redline and no counterparty comment, which matches the rule's instruction to mark compliant and not redline where no MFN burdens the Customer.

The cited paragraphs (p0084 fee payment obligation, p0065 and p0077 maintenance/repair fee provisions) contain no pricing-parity, 'no less favourable', best-price or third-party-offer-matching language, supporting the conclusion that no MFN obligation is imposed on Sparkling (Customer).

Redline text is identical to the originals and no deterministic check failures were raised, so there is no directional or drafting error to correct; the preferred position (no MFN burdening Customer) is satisfied and the absence of a Vendor-granted MFN is not a deviation under this rule.
